correctness.rationale: Reconstructed all compatibility and associativity equations in the fixed basis. In odd characteristic the full five-parameter space has a single two-by-two determinantal equation and a free coordinate, giving dimension four and \(q^4+q^3-q^2\) labeled points. In characteristic two the full ten-parameter space has exactly six explicitly given associativity equations. The s!=0 idempotent split yields \((q-1)q^2(q^3+q^2-q)\). The s=0 quotient is a two-dimensional trace-zero associative algebra; enumerating its multiplicative characters and the rank-one linear extension system gives \(2q^5+q^4-q^3-q^2\). Their sum is the claimed even-field formula and shows dimension six. The exact package checker verify.py checked compatibility rank, every basis identity in full small-field parameter enumerations, and four even/three odd test fields; this is corroboration, not the proof. The zero multiplication is included, and the polynomial identity is expressly used without dividing by two.

originality.rationale: The characteristic-zero Theorem 12 for the identical triangular Lie algebra is acknowledged as covering abstract isomorphism classification, but its explicit hypothesis excludes characteristic two. The new theorem enumerates labeled products on a fixed Lie algebra over every finite field and proves a characteristic-two dimension jump by classifying trace-zero quotient algebra/character pairs and their square-zero extensions. Those consequences are not supplied by the inspected characteristic-zero classifications or retrieved published records. Searches for the exact object, modular aliases, arithmetic fingerprint and extension formulation revealed no decisive equivalent statement. Remaining modular-literature risk is documented; a failed search is not treated as novelty proof.
residual_risks: An unindexed modular associative-extension classification could imply the characteristic-two enumeration under different terminology.
Some traditions define half-derivations only when two is invertible; the result carefully concerns the literal integral polynomial identity, not those conventions.

The odd-characteristic determinantal case may be recoverable as a straightforward refinement of known characteristic-zero tables; originality rests primarily on the modular point formula and dimension jump.

value.rationale: The exact characteristic-two point count is a motivated structural classification for the smallest nonabelian triangular matrix Lie algebra, extending a characteristic-zero theory across a genuinely exceptional characteristic. A trace-zero quotient/character/extension stratification explains a dimension jump from four to six and gives exact zeta functions for all finite fields. This is a natural complete finite-field invariant, not a renamed complex isomorphism class or an arbitrary finite sample. Potential use includes modular transposed-Leibniz deformation moduli and arithmetic comparison of operadic identities. The problem does not require solving automorphism-orbit classification, and no such result is claimed.
